title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less row at a holder's exact address answers one thing on every read and in every hydration state: declined for a sealed type, refused with two holders for an overlay type (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXJAMZYj59b5X3KNNXXrJPe)_
Fixes #32568

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no exact, draft or layered read of a package-less row of a name a package holds; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the FROM → TO below.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不属于任何包的元数据行（package-less row）在某个持有包的精确地址（`?package=X`）上，按类型类别只给一种答案：可覆盖类型（email_template、dashboard、report）两个包同名时，草稿读、预览、分层读的 draft 层也一律 409 列出全部持有者；封闭类型（action、queue、hook 等）一律不采用这行，返回持有包自己的条目；读侧回填不再把这行塞进「第一个注册的包」的槽位。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 与 ADR-0126 Regime C，按专题裁决 6817768147 落实：同一行数据在回填前后、草稿与正式读之间答案不同，属于「歧义被猜而不是被报告」（专题红线 2）。
- 风险与回滚：只改读路径，不改存储与 schema；第一方组合里没有两个包同名又带无包行的情况，计数为 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`（回填不再借第一个包的外壳）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`（草稿与预览出口）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`declinedCopyReplaced`，平读与分层读的 code 层都先过它）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 `[#32568]` 一组覆盖四种状态 × 两种注册顺序。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A package-less row (a `sys_metadata` row bound to no package, or its copy in the registry's bare slot after a hydration) met at a holder's exact address now answers one thing on every read and in every hydration state, by type class (epic ruling 6817768147 on this card; ADR-0150 D4, ADR-0126 Regime C):

- **Overlay types** (`email_template`, `dashboard`, `report`): the row is a holder's customization. Two holders: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-closure`, naming every holder, on the strict draft read, the preview and the layered `draft` layer as on the active read; the list scoped to a holder no longer previews such a draft. One holder: served, as before.
- **Sealed managed types** (artifact-backed, no overlay channel): the row is declined on every read at the address (active and its registry or service copy, strict draft, preview, layered read with its `code` layer, layered `draft` layer). The address serves the holder's own shipped item, with one holder or two. The bare read of a two-holder name keeps its `409`.
- **The read-side hydrator** (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`) never borrows an envelope through a package-less `lookupArtifactItem`: a package-less row wears its one holder's envelope, none with two holders, and a sealed type's declined row is not registered at all. A copy registered before the package arrived is healed by the one heal walk.
- **Upgrade guide**: semantic entry `package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class.ts`), registered by the changeset (`adr-0087: registered`), with its own `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset. The remedy for a sealed type turns on whether it has a declared override channel (ADR-0146): `flow` and `action` (under D9's conditions), `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book` and `mapping` move the change to a declared override in the holder's `.custom` package; every other sealed type (`hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule`, `agent`, `skill`, `api`, …) has none, so the row is deleted and the change ships in a new version of the holding package, or lives under a name no package ships.

Branch note (Duplicate Fix Guard): this branch, `claude/project-thread-pjmygu`, continues `claude/project-thread-cyidlz@191cd2fab` (the previous holder's pushed WIP for this card) with `origin/main` merged in, never rebased; `claude/project-thread-cyidlz` is left as it was.

Merges with `main` after the ACCEPT on `a5a3a66a9` (no rebase):
- `7b43a0f74` merges `7e7277c98` (#32719, #32740). Three hunks in two files, each a union: `readMetaItem`'s and `getMetaItemLayered`'s host `Pick` carry main's `getServicesRegistry` beside this branch's `isStoredEntryOfDeclinedName`; the layered read imports main's `judgeDroppedServiceRefusal` and `servedFromDisabledHolder` beside this branch's `packageScopedRefusalOf`. Main's changes judge the bare read (no package), this branch's the exact address; main still pins the `lead` route on the environment's item, so row 11's FROM stands.
- `5659f216d` merges `2f80f2897` (#32497, the served holder set). One textual hunk: both sides appended a describe to `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`; both are kept. Beside it, a second kind of hand edit, in the same file: three of #32497's pins asserted the D4 customization answer for a sealed type with the other holder disabled (`agent`; `action` plain and layered); by ruling 6817768147 they now pin the holder's own item with #32497's answer named in the title (row 13). `dashboard` keeps #32497's answer. `533a4f932` adds pins for one holder disabled while the read-side hydrator runs, then re-enabled (`email_template`, `action`, `queue`): one answer per state, nothing left behind by the hydration.

### FROM → TO

| # | Read (at `?package=X` unless named) | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Overlay type, two holders, package-less draft: strict draft read, preview, layered `draft` layer | 200, the package-less draft at both holders | 409 `ambiguous-in-closure` naming both | narrowing |
| 2 | Overlay type, two holders: list scoped to a holder with drafts previewed | previews the package-less draft | the holder's own item | narrowing |
| 3 | Sealed type (`action`), package-less draft, one holder or two: strict draft read / preview / layered `draft` layer | 200 the draft / the draft / the draft | 404 no draft / the holder's own active item / `null` | narrowing |
| 4 | Sealed type, two holders, after the read-side hydrator (state 2) | 200, the stored body served as the first-registered holder's own | 200, each holder's own | narrowing |
| 5 | Sealed type, two holders, bare-slot copy stamped `''` or `sys_metadata` (state 3) | `action` 409 naming both; `queue` the copy | 200, each holder's own | widening for `action` with two holders; narrowing for `queue` |
| 5b | `agent`, `skill`, `app`: the environment's item, or a package-less registry copy stamped `''` or `sys_metadata`, of a name a package ships (the `[#31699]` pins, which now hold the overlay types `dashboard` and `report` only) | two holders: 409 naming both; one holder: the item | each holder's own | widening with two holders; narrowing with one |
| 6 | Sealed type, one holder or two: layered read `?layers=true` | two holders: `action` 409 naming both, `queue` reported the row as each holder's `overlay`; one holder: the row reported as the holder's `overlay` | `overlay: null`, the holder's own as `effective` | widening for `action` with two holders; narrowing otherwise |
| 7 | Sealed type, one holder, after the read-side hydrator: exact read and bare read (the one-holder flip) | the stored body | the holder's own item, before and after | narrowing |
| 8 | `hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule`: environment item of a name two packages hold (location 2) | the environment's item at both holders | each holder's own | narrowing |
| 9 | `action`, one holder: the environment's item (the #32407 control) | the environment's item | the holder's own action | narrowing |
| 10 | Registry-direct read of a sealed `app` / `page` with a package-less stored row (what nav code reads) | the stored body under the package's envelope | the package's own definition | narrowing |
| 11 | The bare `/actions/:object/NAME` route (names no package) on an object neither of two holders binds, with the environment's package-less action bound there | the environment's item, found through the first holder's exact address (`?package=<first>` served it, stamped as that holder's, so the first holder's own route on its own object answered no declaration; the second holder's served its own) | no declaration (not a refusal); the execution face reading the environment's own item is #32751 | narrowing |
| 12 | Sealed type (`action`, `queue`), one holder or two: layered read's `code` layer when the `metadata` service answers a package-less copy of the declined row | one holder: the copy as the holder's `code` and `effective`; two holders: `action` 409 naming both, `queue` the copy | the holder's own as `code` and `effective`, as the plain read already answered | widening for `action` with two holders; narrowing otherwise |
| 13 | Sealed type (`agent`; `action` on the plain and the layered read; `queue`; the other sealed types move the same way, as rows 5 and 8 cover them), two holders, one of them disabled (the served holder set of #32497), then re-enabled | `main` with #32497: the enabled holder's address served the environment's item (the layered read reported a stored row as its `overlay`); re-enabled, 409 naming both | the holder's own item (`overlay: null`), disabled or re-enabled; the disabled holder's address still answers its withheld item | narrowing while one is disabled; widening for re-enabled `action` and `agent` (as row 5) |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: the bare read of a two-holder `action` (409, after the hydrator too); an overlay type's package-less row with one holder (served on every exit, and the hydrator lays it in under that holder's envelope); `email_template` with two holders (409 naming both, before and after the hydrator, and the first holder's slot keeps its own).

The widening in rows 5, 5b, 6 and 12 (`action`, and `agent`, `skill`, `app`, with two holders: 409 → 200 the holder's own item) rests on the epic ruling on this card, 6817768147: with the row declined, `?package=X` serves X's own shipped item, exactly as it would with no row stored. The same declining moves an answer on the dataset query door (`POST /analytics/dataset/query` and its batch door), which reads each holder at its exact address (#32804): with a package-less `dataset` row beside two holders, each holder's exact read no longer refuses, so #32804's "every holder's own read refuses → 503 for every caller" no longer fires for that composition. The bare, `?callerPackage=` and non-holder `?package=` arms move from 503 to the admission-judged answer (404 admitted to neither; 200 running the one admitted holder; 409 naming only the admitted holders), and `?package=<holder>` moves from 503 to that holder's own dataset (widening). The package-less row never runs. Measured on `023ace703` with #32804's rig: alpha admitted only → bare and `?callerPackage=` 200 `alpha_item`, `?package=<non-holder>` 409 naming alpha alone; neither admitted → 404; both → 409. No `@objectstack/rest` product code changes, so no rest changeset.

No export is added: `declinesPackageLessRowAt`, `isPackageLessRow` and `declinedCopyReplaced` are module-internal (not in `src/index.ts`).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: a new `[#32568]` describe. Locations 1 and 3 (draft exits, overlay two holders refused, one-holder CONTROL, sealed declined with one holder and two); location 2 (the five types); location 4 for `action` and `queue` in four states (not hydrated, after the read-side hydrator, bare-slot copy stamped `''`, stamped `sys_metadata`) × both registration orders, the one-holder flip, the bare-read CONTROL, and the overlay CONTROL. The `[#31699]` and `[#32407]` pins whose answers this moves are rewritten in place with the old answer named in the title.
- `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts`, `protocol-registry-shadow.test.ts`: the legacy first-match graft pins now pin that a sealed type's package-less row is not registered over the package's item.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (contract review S1): a `metadata` service answering a package-less copy, for `action` and `queue` with one holder and two: the plain read and the layered read's `code` layer both answer the holder's own. All four failed before the layered fix (the `code` layer answered `stored`, or 409 for `action` with two holders) and pass after it.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: the describe's docblock now states the route reads each holder's exact address, where the package-less copy is declined (#32751 for the execution face).
- `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the census rows for the hydrator's lookup and the new `declinedCopyReplaced` lookup.
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` (merge queue, after #32804): #32804's two `503` cases (`a holder whose own exact-qualifier read refuses…`, `?package= naming a holder whose own address refuses…`) made each holder's exact read refuse by registering a package-less `dataset` row beside both holders. `dataset` is a sealed type, so that row is now declined at each holder's address and the read serves the holder's own (the queue run read `404` and `200` where `503` was pinned). The cases now throw that read's former refusal (`ambiguous-in-closure` naming both holders) from the holder's exact read, so the `503` they pin is unchanged; a new `[#32568]` pin holds the declined row: `?package=` runs the holder's own dataset. Ablation: without the rig both cases fail, 2 failed / 55 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Sweep of other exact-read exits: the active read, strict draft read, preview, layered read and its `draft` layer, and the scoped list's preview are judged here. The history, audit and diff doors (`/meta/:type/:name/history` and siblings) read the event ledger by `(type, name)` and serve no item at an exact address; they are not swept by this PR.
- Line budget: 14 files, +725 −89, under the ruling's ~1500, so location 4 ships here, not in a second PR.
- Not in this PR, filed under #32568 and on hold: the bare read of a one-holder name before a heal walk still answers a copy registered before the package arrived (row 7's bare half is pinned for the hydrated states only), #32752.
- Not in this PR (contract review S4 on `533a4f932`; epic red-line read 6835864200: this PR need not heal it, #32820 (p1, under #32568) carries the re-enable heal): with one of two holders disabled, the read-side hydrator lays an overlay type's package-less row into the enabled holder's registry slot under its envelope, and re-enabling the other holder does not re-hydrate, so registry-direct readers of that slot (`getPackageScopedItem`), the list scoped to it and its execution list answer the environment's row as the holder's own until the next unscoped hydration. Measured on `533a4f932`: `email_template` A's slot holds `env en-US` stamped `com.acme.alpha` after B is re-enabled; `action` and `queue` slots hold each holder's own (#32752 comment 6835724023). The protocol's exact reads are unaffected (409 naming both, pinned); the pin's title and comment now claim the exact read only and name this case.
- Row 11 moves a pin of seat ruling B (`packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, case 2): the route's answer on `lead` rode the defect this card closes. Measured on `origin/main`'s metadata-protocol source under this branch's test: `?package=alpha` answered the environment's item (`env`, on `lead`) and `?package=beta` its own (`beta`, on `contact`). The execution face reading the environment's own item (`_env`) is #32751, as ruling B records.
- First-party count: 0 (no composition here has two packages holding one name with a package-less row; the full dogfood battery is run on the final head and reported on the card).
